visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair wearing a white t-shirt with a small graphic holds a brown cardboard box with the black 'ULTRAHUMAN' logo centered on it toward the camera. He stands in an indoor space with a gray kitchen counter and a white wall containing an air conditioner in the background. (2) The camera transitions to a close-up of the man's hands as he demonstrates a thick gold-colored ring on his finger, moving his hand to catch the light. The setting remains the same, but the focus is strictly on the hand and its micro-movements. (3) The man then speaks directly to the camera, using expressive hand gestures while the camera alternates between a medium head-and-shoulders shot and a tighter close-up of his face and the gold ring on his hand. (4) A series of close-up unboxing shots follows, where the man's hands are seen peeling away the perforated security strips of the cardboard box on a wooden table. (5) He opens the outer box to reveal a clean white inner box with the word 'AIR' printed in large black block letters. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the texture of the packaging. (6) The man opens the white box to reveal a new gold smart ring resting in a precise foam cutout. He uses his thumb and forefinger to pick it up and rotate it, showing the black interior sensors. (7) He places the new gold ring next to a thicker, silver-colored ring (identified as 'Cudis' by text) on the wooden surface for a side-by-side comparison, highlighting the difference in width and finish. (8) Further unboxing reveals small black accessories: a square charging pedestal, a circular box labeled 'GET WIRED' containing a black braided cable, and four branded 'ULTRAHUMAN' stickers. (9) The man returns to a talking-head format, gesturing with both rings on his hand as he continues his explanation. (10) The video ends on a static graphic overlay showing the man sitting in the open trunk of a blue car, accompanied by social media call-to-action text.
